summary: The escort now opens with a skippable intro (VoyageIntro, ArkEscortIntro.asset): when the Ark sets sail the camera shows the Ark, the squad and the course for about 18 s while the pilot's own vessel flies on the escort AI with the stick held; the departure banner moves to after the hand-over. The escort sim (aiLocal) has no intro. Milestone 1, Shombith 2026-11-16.
